static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.social_status: The relationship with the spouse is affected by avoiding driving-related activities; tends to avoid social activities involving driving or transport; the spouse is generally supportive but the client finds it hard to communicate deeply on this specific problem
static_traits.medical_history: not yet有类似心理问题史；not yet接受心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude, clear logical thinking, able to self-reflect and identify cognitive biases; expressing self-labeling and catastrophizing tendencies (such as 'failure', 'terrible athlete'); fairly high cooperation; prone to self-blame and perfectionistic demands under pressure, and less patient with family after emotional setbacks

basic_info.main_problem: 因为not会驾驶而认为自己是“失败者”，引发自卑与without价值感，并导致对驾驶与交通相关的社交活动的回避。
basic_info.core_demands: The impact of this belief on my self-esteem and daily life made me realize I need professional help and support.
growth_experiences: 青少年晚期开始因社会对驾驶的期待与压力，将“not会开车”与“失败者/not被认可”相连结；近几年该信念更为突出。曾尝试参加驾驶课程，但恐惧与Anxiety过强而难以坚持。
几个月前因恶劣天气错过跑步，trigger强烈自我批评与标签化（如“我是糟糕的Athlete”）；此后只要计划受阻（如跑步、做饭not理想），便倾向将局部失误泛化为“我在所有事情上都失败”，并出现对家人更易怒、耐心下降的情况。

core_beliefs: 只要not能按计划坚持，我就是失败者（条件性自我价值）

special_situations.event: 看到他人开车或在谈话中出现驾驶话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not会开车，就说明我not合格、会被社会与他人negate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避涉及驾驶与交通的社交场景；尝试报名驾驶课程但因Anxiety过强而Withdrawal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not能开车，所以I am a failure/not如do not人

special_situations.event: 因恶劣天气错过一次跑步，导致训练计划not yet按时完成
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能严格按计划执行，就等于彻底失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 下次更用力逼迫自己以“补偿”失误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not坚持就是失败者；我在所有事情上都失败

special_situations.event: 家务任务（如做饭）出现小失误，结果not如Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有任何瑕疵，就证明I cannot do anything well
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加强自我批评、提高完美标准与控制感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就是在所有事情上都很糟糕/not行

special_situations.event: 在事务顺利时仍担心下一次挑战会出问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 好结果只是侥幸，下一次很可能又会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 持续紧张、提前自我加压以避免“再次失败”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 下次很可能又会出状况/我很难维持好状态

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可、被视为有能力和值得的人
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被他人评判与negate、担心被视为失败者而感到羞耻
defense_goal: 通过Avoids driving相关场景与自我苛责来降低被评判的风险并维持控制感

object_relations.object_representation: 社会/他人是严苛的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites her to view the 'failure' label from a more balanced perspective or proposes concrete practice steps
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feels their real plight may be simplified, worried they will again have to 'meet the standard' and be judged
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、Empathy的语气肯定其逻辑能力，同时邀请其关注当下情绪与身体感受；减少说理性劝导的密度，use开放式Questioning与具象化练习，帮助其在安全氛围中命名羞愧与Anxiety。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到跑步错过或家务失误的细节时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将外界not利因素内化为对自我的全责归因，认为问题都在自己身上
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 降低评判性语言，use肯定与正常化策略；通过区分可控与not可控因素的对话，引导其将not合理的全责归因外化，并练习更公平的自我叙述。

manifestations: 将“not会开车”与“I am a failure/not值得”相连，觉得自身价值取决于是否符合社会期待（能否驾驶）
outcomes: Avoids socializing与活动导致生活范围缩小

manifestations: Feeling bound by social rules (everyone should be able to drive), finding it hard to define value by one's own standards
outcomes: 决策与生活Freedom度降低（not愿参与涉驾驶的活动）

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: use苛刻的自我标签（失败者、糟糕的Athlete）
把局部失误视为整体失败并严厉评判自己

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: 在错过跑步后把压力与攻击性转向自己，逼迫自己下次更用力
对外在因素（如天气）导致的失误，更多通过自责来处理

positive_force: 具备家务管理的有效能力（日常能胜任家庭职责）
有支持性的配偶可倾诉
愿意寻求专业帮助并参与结构化练习
能够识do not并讨论自身的认知偏差（逻辑上能看到not合理）
曾主动尝试通过驾驶课程来改变现状
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
自我标签化与过度概括
对驾驶的恐惧与Anxiety导致回避
对社会期待的Introjection较强，依赖外部评价来界定自我价值
因自责与压力导致对家人更易怒、耐心下降

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与驾驶和交通相关的社交活动与日常事务
antecedent: 需要参与需要驾驶/交通安排的活动
target_behavior.core_reason: 将社会期待内化为个人价值判断（not会开车=失败者），伴随灾难化担心被评判与羞耻
target_behavior.function: 逃避被评判与羞耻情境，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 跑腿与Restricted social participation，生活范围缩小，与配偶关系受影响

target_behavior.behavior: 在计划受阻时的自我苛责与负性标签化（如错过跑步、做饭not理想即认为“我在所有事情上都失败”）
antecedent: 恶劣天气导致跑步中断
target_behavior.core_reason: Conditional self-worth and perfectionist standards (counting as valuable only if plan targets are met), accompanied by all-or-nothing and overgeneralization cognitive biases
target_behavior.function: 通过自我施压试图维持控制感与防止再次失败
target_behavior.consequence: 挫败感与Anxiety worsened，对家庭更易怒与耐心下降，整体Impaired self-esteem
